entry_points.text: Table selects handler by exit reason covering exceptions, interrupts, faults, registers, descriptors, TLB, APIC, task, pause, virtualization, bus lock and notify.
IRQ-off dispatcher returns early when emulation needed; else forwards external, exception/NMI and machine-check entries and ignores rest.
Trace interrupt returns zero when idle or not in nested NMI; else queues perf request, sets overflow and returns one.
State and PKRU switch on mismatch; sensitive ops check privilege and advance or inject; monitor/wait fault or noop.
Guest TSC scales delta plus last value with sequence sampling; Hyper-V CPUID fills via helper; attributes serve XCR0 or vendor hook for get versus probe.

exports.text: Tunables cover timer, TSC tolerance, backdoor, prefix, posted timer, SMT, APICv, IPI, device IRQs and width.
Clock refresh, extension query and device control are callable externally, routing CPUID, MSR, MCE and attribute ioctls.

hazards.text: Unexpected VE, coincident events, CLTS violation, NMI window without support, unknown CR op and real-mode GP without backdoor warn or fail.
Two messages warn of L1TF leakage when threading stays on or mitigation is off.
Guest device access with cacheable attributes risks host machine checks, forcing uncacheable type.
Uncalibrated, zero, unscalable or out-of-range TSC warns and uses safe fallback; zero rate aborts and re-requests; stale reads retry.
Steal aborts silently on user or mapping faults yet still dirties page when mapping was reached.

invariants.text: IRQ-off triage captures async flags, saves extended error on device fault, handles machine check and brackets external interrupts.
Exception/NMI filters MC/NMI, queues device/opcode, rejects VE, uses present codes, emulates backdoor, reports coincidences, delegates PF and handles v86, BP, DB, AC or userspace.
Triple fault reports shutdown and clears memory state; I/O counts and emulates string ops or decodes port, width and direction.
CR exits decode target and direction; nested writes merge hypervisor bits and update shadow for CR0/3/4/8, LMSW, TPR and CLTS failure.
DR exits validate number, map general-detect to host or guest, enforce privilege and move values; DR4/5 alias only when extensions off.
INVLPG invalidates then skips; APIC shortcuts EOI and emulates writes; task switch decodes reason; EPT restores NMI block, traces and delegates.
Pause tunes spin window; monitor and log-full noop; INVPCID checks caps; NMI and threshold update events; VMX/TDX/ENCLS fault; bus lock records; notify reports or resumes; MSR-imm delegates.
Host RSP updates only on change; device memory is uncacheable with optional guest-ignore; timers rearm when pinned; MSR helpers map ranges and access.
Control shadows write hardware only on change; enlightened use tracks static flag with per-CPU pointer.
TSC rates apply tolerance window with scaling or catchup; master-clock use counts atomically.
Master needs stable TSC; record holds version, flags, shift, scale, TSC and time versioned with dirty mark; per-VCPU prefers master or scaled TSC; refresh kicks; flush clears.
Steal with version, preempted and counter validates mapping then versions; MWAIT needs timer; masks, type and sync check features; LAPIC syncs; Xen forces running; per-CPU caches last vCPU.

locks.text: Vendor operation install is serialized by a dedicated mutex.
Global time holds TSC write lock with sequence bracketing; guest clock uses IRQ-saving reader lock with drop-and-refresh on failure.

state_machines.text: Handlers return positive to reenter, zero to userspace and negative on bad config; debug, shutdown and notify use zero while faults and skips stay positive.
RDTSCP needs nested timestamp ID else faults; I/O consults bitmaps; descriptor, halt and pause check controls; rest unhandleable; accepted validate length then synthesize exit.
Exit check prepares transfer then reports pending when exiting, any flag set or work pending.
Multiplier records L1, combines with L2 when nested active, then pushes to hardware if scaling exists.
Refresh broadcasts in-progress, locks blocking entry, updates copy, unlocks, then requests per-VCPU updates and clears marker.

structs.text: Staging holds count, array and user value; segments order selector, base, limit, rights; trace holds control, status, ranges and copies; caps are 7/4 MSRs, 8 entries, 4 ranges, 512 log head-last and freeze debug.
Nested tracks enablement, controls, bitmaps, timers and IRQs; per-vCPU embeds CPU with controls, autoload, segments and trace; per-VM adds TSS and tables.

Entry needs debug load plus long-mode on 64-bit; exit needs debug save and IRQ ack; pin needs IRQ/NMI; primary needs halt, paging, I/O, debug, windows; secondary/tertiary add APIC, paging, IPI; lazy covers regs.
Masks fix hypercall, PMU, debug, X2APIC, clock, quirks, bus lock, notify; XCR0 spans FP, vector, bound, wide, PK, tile plus CET XSS; FEP clears resume.
Clock holds mode, cycles, mask, multiplier and offsets with global copies; stats expose VM MMU and vCPU fault, exit and emulation counters plus cache.
Many true; dynamic cover pre-fault, APIC, masks, Xen, sync, clock, SMM, CPU counts, MCE, XSAVE, TSC, X2APIC, nested size, flush, width, steal, bus lock/quirks.
Userspace uses debug with PC, exception with vector/code, internal error with four words, plus shutdown, priority and notify.
